gloss: all around; everywhere around; on all sides

definitions.gloss: all around; everywhere around; on all sides
definitions.explanation: The entire area surrounding a person or thing, emphasizing that every direction is included.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}{花|はな}だらけだった。
{周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}の{人|ひと}がこちらを{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: Everyone around was looking this way.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}に{本|ほん}が{積|つ}み{上|あ}げられていて、{足|あし}の{踏|ふ}み{場|ば}もなかった。
examples.english: Books were piled up all around the room, and there wasn't even room to stand.

notes:
Combines {周|まわ}り (surroundings) with {中|じゅう} (throughout), a suffix that emphasizes completeness across an area. Expresses that something extends in every direction without gaps.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}が{敵|てき}: enemies on all sides
- {周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}: pitch dark all around
- {周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread all around

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {辺|あた}り{一面|いちめん}: the whole area — emphasizes a surface or landscape covered uniformly
- {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}: in all directions — more literary, emphasizes directions rather than proximity
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}: everywhere — broader scope, not limited to the immediate surroundings
